PCS-WEB 0.3.0 API

Packages 
Package Description
org.tmt.aps.peas
Misc top level Beans and Constants: managing all requests and sessions, properties, constants.
org.tmt.aps.peas.common
Utility classes for managing coordinate data, lists of coordinates, encoding coordinates lists to and from string formats that are used to store coordinate lists in a database; the package also contains utilities for generating messages using resource bundles and utilities for generating error and success messages for all cases in PEAS (record update, procedure execution, command execution and generic).
org.tmt.aps.peas.common.cdi
CDI (Component Dependency Injection) related classes that define annotations specific to PEAS-PCS.
org.tmt.aps.peas.common.ui
Common user interface components supporting field display using metadata stored in the database.
org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business
Computation library EJB and computation exception classes.
org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.java
Computations implemented in Java.
org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model
Computation result data classes: each class name is unique to a computation so that automated data collection into ProcedureOutput subclasses can be performed without conflict.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business
Database updates/queries for constants, global configuration, procedure configuration; configuration data caches; real-time configuration of external interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model
Data models and database entities for procedure configuration, global configuration, computation configuration, constants and procedure execution preferences.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.ui
JSF controllers and converters supporting global configuration, sufs zernike orders and missing spots user interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business
ACS, DCS, PCS camera and PCS CCD command interfaces and simulators.
org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.model  
org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.ui
JSF Controllers for ACS, DCS, Camera and CCD manual and diagnostic user interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business
CCD Frame file and database reading/writing; Frame simulation; Frame marking utilities.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model
Data classes related to CCD frames; database entities, FITS file data, marking data.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.ui
Controller and related classes for frame tools user interface.
org.tmt.aps.peas.help.ui
Help screens related JSF Controller and servlets for serving HTML and image content
org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.business
Database access EJBs for PCS camera and CCD configuration; Singleton EJB cache of all configuration values and current values.
org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model
PCS instrument configuration data model and database entities.
org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.ui
JSF Controllers and Converters for instrument configuration user interfaces
org.tmt.aps.peas.lang.interop
Generated Java JNI wrapper classes; These classes have all been generated using the J2F utility.
org.tmt.aps.peas.lang.interop.examples  
org.tmt.aps.peas.lang.interop.test
Stand-alone testing classes for various J2F generated Java wrapper classes.
org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business
Procedure execution management, procedure execution state, procedure store and retrieval, procedure output store and retrieval.
org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.exception
Exception classes that are specific to procedure execution: procedure abort and failures that occur when centroiding a frame
org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.executor
Executors for procedures and subflows implemented as Singleton EJBs.
org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model
Procedure database related entities and the complete procedure output class hierarchy
org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui
Procedure user interface Controllers managing procedure setup, asynchronous frame display and marking, asynchronous dialog rendering, archived procedure viewing.
org.tmt.aps.peas.refBeamMap.business
Database storing and retrieval of centroid maps, reference beam maps and subimage definitions.
org.tmt.aps.peas.refBeamMap.model
Database entity classes related to centroid maps and reference maps
org.tmt.aps.peas.session.business

org.tmt.aps.peas.session.model
Database entities and interfaces related to night sessions, field metadata and external interface configuration
org.tmt.aps.peas.session.ui
Session related user interface controller, managing external interface connections and access permissions
org.tmt.aps.peas.statusLog.business
Status log cache and database read/writes.
org.tmt.aps.peas.statusLog.model
Status log related data classes
org.tmt.aps.peas.statusLog.ui

org.tmt.aps.peas.tools
